transcriber_notes: SnowPro-style Windows form screenshot (1259x856), no branding -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 14/11/2012 agrees with the file name. Height axis 2.7 px/cm (0 cm at y697). Two dashed table rows: the top '+r 2' leads to 76-65 cm (above HS 65) and is recorded as surface; the second '+r 2' leads to 65-59 cm and matches the narrow F bar, so it is a layer. Leaders give boundaries 65/59/54/36/29/24/21/0 (+-0.5 cm). Hardness from bar widths (origin x614; F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px): F, 4F, 1F- (46 px), P, P+ (148 px), K- (175 px), P+; R-column icons agree (the K- row shows a crossed double-line icon with '-'). Temperatures on 13.4 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline; the slanted dashed air line starts at -4.6 at the plot top vs printed -4.5); first circle at 55 cm, no point at the surface; the line reaches ~0 C at 0 cm without a visible marker (not recorded).
